answer_1.quote: We propose the Knowledge Composition Sampling (KCS), a novel framework ... to generate multi-hop questions from the given answer and sampled knowledge compositions.

answer_2.quote: For diversifying question generation, we use Exact Match (EM), Precision (P), Recall (R), and F1-Score (F1) to evaluate the correctness of the predicted answers ... Additionally, we compute BERTScore (BSc) and Human Evaluation Score (HSc) for semantic evaluation. We also employ Pairwise-BLEU to measure the diversity and LLM-based metrics to measure the diversity and consistency.

answer_3.quote: To further illustrate that the sampled knowledge compositions are logically coherent, we conduct a LLM evaluation and an actual human analysis in Appendix D. ... we also employ LLM-based metrics to measure the diversity and consistency.
